defs.meaning: [计][电子][通信] 帧，[电影] 画面；[建][计] 框架；眼镜架（frame 的复数）

examples.en: The window frames had begun to warp.
The paint was peeling on the window frames.
examples.zh: 窗框上的油漆正在剥落。

examples.en: He was wearing new glasses with gold wire frames.
examples.zh: 他戴着一副新的金丝框眼镜。

synonyms.meaning: 帧，画面；框架；眼镜架（frame的复数）
